answer: Late-Reply Ratchet.** Each agent identity has a latency budget that tightens after every ignored request; replies arriving outside the current window earn decayed trust. Honest agents keep a steady zephyr of timely answers, while a sybil farm must answer promptly across thousands of sockets, forcing costly parallel capacity. Mismatched timing creates a spiral of missed windows that resets reputation to the seed opal tier, so each fake identity demands its own dedicated responder to stay viable.
